'''Phase II pilot armor'''<ref name="CE">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> was worn by [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilots]], especially by [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170]] pilots. It was not totally enclosed and its wearer was only able to survive for one minute in space.

==Behind the scenes==
Phase II clone pilot armor first appeared in the [[Chapter 23 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|the twenty-third chapter]] of ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]''. The helmet's appearance in Chapter 23 is different compared to its appearance in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. In ''Clone Wars'' it appears enclosed, while in ''Revenge of the Sith'' the faces of the clones are shown.
